versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Invoice Generator skill.

- Generates professional, print-ready invoice HTML files from user-provided details.
- Supports both natural language and structured inputs for sender, client, and line items.
- Calculates subtotal, tax, and total automatically; formats currency to two decimal places.
- Prompts user for specifics if input is vague (e.g., missing line items or sender info).
- Outputs are single self-contained HTML files, ready to open, print, or save as PDF.
- Designed for invoice creation only (not for quotes, recurring billing, or contracts).
